stories.title: HP links Diwali to social innovation
stories.summary: HP India has launched its Diwali campaign, Lights of Change, featuring six Indian innovations in areas like accessibility and environmental sustainability. The film highlights projects ranging from a Braille device to agricultural waste solutions. The company says the campaign uses technology to address everyday challenges across communities.

stories.title: Amazon India uses nostalgia for Diwali marketing
stories.summary: Amazon India is running a Diwali campaign titled DeliverTheLove, focusing on sibling bonds and childhood memories. The film follows a man who sends his siblings an empty glass bottle to evoke shared past experiences. The brand aims to highlight the importance of being present during the festival.

stories.title: Tata Starbucks positions coffeehouses as festive venues
stories.summary: Tata Starbucks has launched a Diwali campaign titled Special Diwali ki Special Jagah. The coffee chain is positioning its outlets as settings for meaningful milestones and family connections. The film depicts a couple bringing their family to a regular meeting spot to celebrate the festival together.

stories.title: Hershey’s India targets Diwali party interruptions
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has extended its Giving Kisses Is Hard campaign into the Diwali season. Conceptualised by TBWA Lintas, the digital film uses a humorous narrative about a couple struggling to find privacy during family celebrations. The brand suggests a chocolate kiss as a solution to festive interruptions.

stories.title: South Indian Bank focuses on human relationships
stories.summary: South Indian Bank has launched a Diwali campaign titled Khushiyan Badhao, Diwali Manao. The film is set at an open mic event and asks audience members to define the spirit of the festival. The bank says the campaign draws on its philosophy of investing in relationships.

stories.title: Swiggy rebrands as Sweety for Diwali
stories.summary: Swiggy has temporarily changed its display name to Sweety for its festive campaign. The food delivery platform updated its Instagram bio to Sweets you on time and ran a front page print advertisement. The campaign uses references to a 1971 Bollywood song to drive engagement.

stories.title: AJIO launches astronaut-led shopping campaign
stories.summary: AJIO has introduced a Diwali campaign called Ghar Wapsi, featuring a mystery astronaut who orbits the Earth to unlock shopping deals. The interactive experience invites consumers to track the astronaut over different cities. The brand says the campaign centers on the theme of homecoming.

stories.title: Apple collaborates with Raw Mango for Diwali film
stories.summary: Apple has released a Diwali campaign titled Step Into the Light, created with fashion brand Raw Mango. Shot on the iPhone 18 Pro, the film features traditional textiles, dance and music. The company says the campaign celebrates the elements that define the festival.

stories.title: Apple Diwali film sparks debate on luxury
stories.summary: Apple's Step Into the Light campaign has prompted viewer discussion regarding its focus on visual spectacle. While some praise the cinematography and music, others argue the film prioritizes luxury over the everyday experiences of Diwali. The campaign was directed by Raw Mango founder Sanjay Garg.

stories.title: Somany Bathware highlights flushing noise
stories.summary: Somany Bathware is marketing its Quiet Swirl Wall Hung range by focusing on the sound of toilet flushing. The company suggests that bathroom noise is an overlooked aspect of comfort. The campaign asks if flushing needs to be an uninvited reminder that the bathroom is occupied.

stories.title: Holding companies debate pitch process
stories.summary: A debate has emerged among holding company CEOs regarding whether winning business without a pitch constitutes proper due diligence. The discussion follows Publicis Groupe winning the PepsiCo media account from Omnicom without a formal pitch. The industry remains divided on the future of the traditional agency review.

stories.title: Publicis and WPP trade barbs over client wins
stories.summary: Publicis Groupe has issued an open letter to WPP chief executive Cindy Rose following comments about agency handshakes. Publicis argued that global firms do not hand over data or operations based on personal relationships. The exchange has raised questions about how the industry manages client acquisitions.

stories.title: GTF Technologies wins agency award
stories.summary: GTF Technologies has been named Agency of the Year at the Realty Conclave and Excellence Awards 2026 North. The agency, which focuses on real estate branding and marketing, received the recognition for its work in building property brands. The award was presented in Noida on November 6.

stories.title: This week in ads: Stories, emotions and brand connections take centre stage
stories.summary: Advertising continues to find new ways to turn everyday moments, cultural observations and human emotions into compelling brand stories. From campaigns that tap into nostalgia and relationships to those highlighting identity, aspiration and consumer experiences, brands are exploring narratives that go beyond conventional product-led communication.

stories.title: Criteo partners with Adore Beauty
stories.summary: Criteo has entered a retail media partnership with Australian beauty retailer Adore Beauty. The deal will see Criteo power onsite sponsored products across the retailer's digital platforms in Australia and New Zealand. The offering aims to reach customers during product discovery and purchase moments.

stories.summary: W Group has appointed a director to the leadership team of its social and influencer agency, HelloFranses!. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Ranking India's LinkedIn marketing agencies
stories.summary: India's B2B marketers have shifted LinkedIn from an afterthought to a primary demand-generation channel. A new ranking of the top 10 agencies for 2026 draws on survey data and a curated list of B2B specialists, mixing full-service digital shops with pure-play paid-social outfits.

stories.title: Sorting the influencer agency market
stories.summary: Influencer marketing is essential for competitiveness, with 67% of marketers intending to partner with creators. Brands often pay for follower counts rather than results while trying to avoid the manual vetting process. This article attempts to clear the clutter among hundreds of agencies promising identical deliverables.

stories.title: Creator economy projected to hit $217 billion
stories.summary: The global creator economy is worth an estimated $217.3 billion in 2026, up 26.2% from 2025. The report projects $570.6 billion by 2030, though a conservative scenario accounting for AI content diluting pricing suggests a lower figure of $380.1 billion. Growth has risen every year since 2021.

stories.title: Facebook offers $5,000 video series bonus
stories.summary: Meta has offered some creators a $5,000 bonus for publishing a five-part video series. Requirements include 60-second episodes and 10,000 views per video. One creator noted that he had previously only posted random reels, but the platform now requires a specific story to unlock the payment.

stories.title: Creator economy event calendar for late 2026
stories.summary: The latest creator economy calendar includes 10 events from November 9 through December 10, 2026. Locations range from Lisbon to Bangkok, covering topics from beauty and wellness to affiliate marketing. The events target a mix of executives, creative professionals, and senior marketing leaders.

stories.title: Global influencer-following rates vary by region
stories.summary: Africa has the highest average influencer-following rate at 33.4%, with all five surveyed markets exceeding the United States. While influencer culture is often associated with the U.S., following personalities is more common in several countries across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Ghana currently leads the global ranking.

stories.title: Funke Akindele recounts influencer snub
stories.summary: Nollywood filmmaker Funke Akindele reported a failed attempt to collaborate with a content creator for her 2024 film. Akindele stated she offered to pay for the partnership, but the influencer declined through management and eventually stopped responding. The industry remains a place of varying professional standards.

stories.title: Pakistan holds first influencer awards
stories.summary: Karachi hosted the inaugural Pakistan Influencer Awards 2026, featuring 30 categories organized by brand marketing and tech experts. Curated by Talha Aslam, the event aims to provide formal recognition for digital creators. Participants hope the awards will pave the way for future industry validation in the country.

stories.title: Political creator economy shifts since 2024
stories.summary: Political media once revolved around a small group of podcast hosts who became essential stops for presidential candidates. Two years later, the landscape has changed. The creator economy continues to evolve, and the influence of the manosphere on political outcomes remains a subject of ongoing analysis.

stories.title: Social media stars visit MSU for blood drive
stories.summary: Social media personalities Joshua Cauldwell-Clarke and Jason Riley visited Michigan State University to promote the Abbott and Big Ten blood donation effort. The pair met with the university culinary team to learn about campus food service. The tour continues across various Big Ten campuses.

stories.title: Pakistan influencer awards announce winners
stories.summary: The inaugural Pakistan Influencer Awards took place in Karachi, honoring social media figures across 30 categories. The event followed months of performance data analysis and jury evaluation. Chief curator Talha Aslam stated the platform intends to set meaningful standards for recognition within the local creator community.

stories.title: YouTube tests product recommendation hub
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a hub that algorithmically recommends products for creators to tag in videos. The shelf displays items based on channel niche and audience engagement, alongside estimated commission rates. The platform aims to prompt a higher volume of relevant brand content partnerships through automated suggestions.

stories.title: YouTube Studio adds affiliate product shelf
stories.summary: YouTube Studio is rolling out personalized product recommendations for eligible shopping affiliates. The feature displays items with estimated commission rates to assist creators in planning content. Suggestions are based on past uploads and trending topics within the creator's specific niche. The platform is now a shopping assistant.

stories.summary: YouTube is updating its recommendation system to prioritize original content and reduce the reach of re-uploaded videos. The platform claims this effort will deliver a better viewing experience for its user base. Shorts currently generates over 200 billion daily views. The algorithm is now being asked to judge creativity.

stories.title: YouTube Shorts algorithm now prioritizes original content creators
stories.summary: YouTube updated its recommendation system on October 1 to prioritize original content and reduce the reach of channels that primarily repost other creators’ videos. The change targets aggregator accounts that built audiences by re-uploading clips with minimal modifications. The platform is now attempting to define what constitutes a creator.

stories.title: YouTube adds music generation and comment moderation tools
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a tool that allows creators to generate royalty-free instrumental tracks to replace copyright-protected audio in their videos. It is also testing a bulk moderation option for comments based on conversational context. The music generation feature is currently limited to United States desktop users of YouTube Studio.

stories.title: YouTube launches cheaper ad-free plan in Vietnam
stories.summary: YouTube is rolling out Premium Lite in Vietnam, priced at VND49,000 per month via web or VND65,000 via app. The plan allows users to watch most videos without ads and supports offline downloads. However, the service does not remove ads from all content. Some ads remain by design.

stories.summary: Ogilvy and CAA have launched ECHO, an AI platform designed to turn celebrity production shoots into creative content systems. stories.title: McKinsey and Parloa partner for customer-facing AI
stories.summary: McKinsey and Parloa have formed an alliance to help enterprises deploy AI agents for customer service. The partnership aims to close the readiness gap preventing firms from managing AI in customer conversations. McKinsey will design the governance frameworks while Parloa provides the platform to build and optimize the agents.

stories.title: Marketing AI access audit: who can act, and where?
stories.summary: Marketing teams are increasingly connecting AI assistants to data warehouses and CRM systems to review campaign performance. Experts suggest auditing what an agent can read, change, or revoke before live campaigns begin. Nobody in the room has yet agreed whether the assistant should have the power to edit budgets.

stories.title: Nooks secures US$500 million for AI sales agents
stories.summary: Nooks has secured a US$500 million non-dilutive financing commitment from General Catalyst to expand its sales automation platform. The company is pairing the capital with Node, an AI assistant intended to pursue sales goals and handle routine follow-ups. Sales software is moving from suggestions toward execution.

stories.title: Priority buys Fireberry to expand CRM automation
stories.summary: Priority Software has acquired Fireberry, adding a CRM platform to its cloud enterprise resource planning business. The companies did not disclose the deal price or a product integration schedule. Priority is proposing a more unified software stack, though the timeline for that unity remains currently undisclosed.

stories.title: AI promises to localise Indian advertising
stories.summary: Agencies claim AI can now create campaigns in 10 languages across 20 markets to bridge the gap between national and local messaging. The technology allows brands to speak to diverse regions at a scale once considered unthinkable. It remains to be seen if the content will actually change.

stories.title: Dior holiday film sparks AI speculation
stories.summary: Viewers identified animation errors in a Dior holiday short, including warped lettering and an extra joint on a character. Online commenters concluded the film used generative AI, reigniting debates over human versus machine production in luxury marketing. Luxury brands are finding that credibility gaps are difficult to bridge.
